facts.statement: Asset FW-13 runs intermittently; diagnosis is not confirmed. Manufacturer advice suggests firmware update 1.2 to 1.3 subject to site sequence review. Customer BMS controls ventilation and occupied temperature; authority, backup, rollback and recommissioning plan are absent.
Sales asks for guaranteed 30% savings with no measured baseline. Site contact asks to disable ventilation interlock to make unit run. No competent review supports that action.
